originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp/failed-search. Nearest priors do not state or mechanically imply the 16-row reflexive-polygon volume-product spectrum or the symmetric {8,9} dichotomy. (1) Harrell-Henrot-Lamboley arXiv:1104.3663 proves continuous 2D local minimizers are parallelograms (global min 8) with no lattice-reflexive table. (2) Kasprzyk-Nill arXiv:1107.4945 confirms the 16-polygon boundary and Twelve-Point property with no Mahler volumes. (3) Baeuerle arXiv:2308.12719, the closest lattice-Mahler work, covers only Fano/IP simplices with upper bounds (2D bound Euclidean-equivalent 9) and simplex equality cases: no quads/quints/hexagon, no full {27/4,8,35/4,9} spectrum, no symmetric gap. (4) arXiv searches: 'volume product reflexive' no results; 'Mahler product' only Gilboa-Segal-Slomka (log-concave functions) and He-Si (discrete lattice-set polarity, cross-polytope minimality), different objects; 'reflexive polygon Mahler' only Bao-He-Zahabi on Mahler measure (polynomial height), not volume product. Vertex lists exist in classification databases (GRDB/KS) but no source tabulates vol x vol-polar over the 16 classes with min/max/equality and symmetric dichotomy. Classical minima 8 and 27/4 are cited background and explicitly disclaimed.

value.rationale: Strongest headline (Theorems A+B) is an exact invariant of a natural object, motivated before computation: the finite GL(2,Z)-classification of 16 reflexive polygons (toric Fano / mirror-symmetry boundary with pre-existing consumers, e.g. brane-tiling dual pairs) crossed with the recognized symmetric Mahler volume-product problem (2D min 8, stability programs). The full spectrum {27/4 (x2), 8 (x6), 35/4 (x4), 9 (x4)} with min on dual triangle pair, max 9 on ids 13-16, plus sharp symmetric dichotomy M in {8,9} (M=8 iff parallelogram; symmetric non-parallelogram min 9, gap G=1) was not known or mechanically implied as a stated result, is precisely stated with witnesses and duality pairing, and is foreseeably reusable as citable polar-volume datum and discrete stability benchmark. Honestly limited to the reflexive family (finite-case gap, not analytic stability). This satisfies the exact-invariant retrieval standard; it is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
